keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Elmwood Park Borough, homeowners pay an average of $12,117.95 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 12.3% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 72.4%, assessed values average ~72.4% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 58.6% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 29.8%, and Bergen County claims 11.6%.
